scope: Queue occurrence reporting on playback timelines

static.observation: The timeline request builder includes playQueueItemID alongside ratingKey, key, state and playback time, without a playQueueID parameter. This is static syntax, not an observed request.

runtime_bootstrap.result: PMS started and answered root/library/preferences endpoints; the private environment has only a loopback interface. This initial capture did not test queues.

implementation_contract.queue_selection: Resolve playQueueItemID only in the caller-owned active queues; optional playQueueID further narrows the lookup. Match the metadata ID before saving playstate. Publish selection only after playstate reports success.
implementation_contract.version: Timeline selection and repeated progress reports do not increment queue version, matching controlled PMS 1.43.4 runtime observation.
